chapters.label: Extra time
chapters.text: Munich, 2012, the Champions League final. Extra time, one-all. Penalty to Bayern! Arjen Robben steps up against his old Chelsea teammate, Petr Čech... saved!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Čech stays big and still, and waits for the kick. Then he pushes off strongly to his left, and stops it.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: Robben wanted it high, but it stays low. The ball spins loose... and Čech pounces on the rebound!

chapters.label: Do your homework
chapters.text: Keepers, do your homework on penalty takers. Stay big, wait, then push off strongly. And always follow the rebound!
